What if every sound on Earth suddenly vanished?
You scream for help... but nobody hears a thing.
No voices. No footsteps. Not even your own heartbeat.
At first, the silence feels peaceful.
Ambulances race through traffic with silent sirens.
Planes lose radio communication. Emergency calls become useless.
Animals that rely on sound struggle to survive.
And here's where it gets terrifying...
You see a massive explosion right in front of you.
If sound waves themselves stopped existing, even your inner ear couldn't detect vibrations.
Your sense of balance could be affected too.
One planet. Twenty-four hours. Absolute silence.
Could humanity survive the quietest day in history?
